# Sukheth Kallupalli

> Personal website of Sukheth K M (Kallupalli) — Associate at the Boston Consulting Group, based in Bangalore, India. IIT Madras alumnus. A small, hand-written digital garden: a short bio, a work history, and notes on the tools he uses.

Canonical: https://sukheth.com
Language: English
Owner: Sukheth K M <sukheth.kallupalli@gmail.com>
Last updated: 2026-09-19

## Pages

- [Home](https://sukheth.com/): who Sukheth is, where he lives, what he does now, plus links to everywhere else. Contact and booking links sit here too.
- [Previously](https://sukheth.com/previously): roles, delegations, and internships in reverse-chronological order.
- [Uses This](https://sukheth.com/uses-this): hardware, software, fitness gear, and coffee setup he uses day to day. Inspired by usesthis.com.
- [Listening](https://sukheth.com/listening): the Rainbow playlist. A decade of Hindi tracks he shared on Instagram, matched across Spotify and YouTube Music.

Every page is plain HTML with no paywall and no JavaScript required to read the content. Markdown sources: https://github.com/Sukheth/sukheth.github.io

## Key facts

- Full name: Sukheth K M (Kallupalli)
- Current role: Associate at the Boston Consulting Group (BCG)
- Based in: Bangalore, India. Studied in Chennai, with brief stays in Noida, London, New Castle, Navi Mumbai, and Pune
- Education: IIT Madras
- Site built with: Jekyll digital garden theme, notes written in Obsidian, hosted on GitHub Pages behind Cloudflare
